title: Small Amounts Burned When Bridging to L1
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The bridgeToL1() function transfers tokens from the escrow to a system address on the EVM to initiate a bridge to L1. However, if the EVM-side token has extra decimal precision (i.e., more than the expected extraEvmWeiDecimals), non-round values (not divisible cleanly by 10**extraEvmWeiDecimals) will result in burned tokens.  This behavior is noted in the protocol's caveats and is systemic to how logs are parsed and how L1 crediting works. However, the bridge logic does not pre-adjust or sanitize these amounts.
